source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: When the first battle round begins, you may name one enemy unit as this unit’s **hunted**. Attacks this unit makes against its **hunted** may re-roll a **[Wound roll](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls)** of 1. Whenever the **hunted** is **destroyed**, you may name up to one further enemy unit as the new **hunted**.
